cues.en: Now that you're done with our email configuration, we shall be using salary workers to facilitate the sending of emails in our application.
cues.zh: 電子郵件組態完成後，接著使用 Celery worker，處理應用程式的寄信功能。

cues.en: For this to work, we're going to create a generic email sending task that the workers will execute when it comes to sending any emails in our application, this is going to be done in the tasks.py file
cues.zh: 要讓它運作，會建立通用寄信工作，應用程式需要寄送任何郵件時，就由 worker 執行。程式寫在 tasks.py，

cues.en: within backend app core emails.
We had created this file in the last lecture.
cues.zh: 上一堂課已建立這個檔案。

cues.en: So let's start.
As you can see from backend dot app, dot co dot app, we're just going to import a salary app.
Then from fast API mail we're going to import the message schema, the message type then the multipart a subtype enum.
cues.zh: 從 fastapi_mail 匯入 MessageSchema、MessageType 與 MultipartSubtypeEnum。

cues.en: Then let's reorganize our imports.
This backend should be below that.
cues.zh: backend 的匯入應該放在下面。

cues.en: And then at the top of the import we should import async IO like that.
Then after the salary app import we're going to say from backend.app.co dot logging we're going to import get logger.
cues.zh: celery_app 之後，從 backend.app.core.logging 匯入 get_logger。

cues.en: Then from backend.app.co dot emails dot config.
Again import fast mail.
Then we can instantiate our logo by saying logo, that's going to be Getlogger.
Then we're going to use a decorator from celery that is going to register a task function as a celery task.
cues.zh: 接著使用 Celery 裝飾器，將函式註冊為 Celery 工作。

cues.en: So which decorator is this?
The decorator is at celery underscore app dot task like that.
So this decorator registers a task function as a celery task.
cues.zh: 它會把工作函式註冊成 Celery 工作。

cues.en: In our case we're going to use this decorator to register a task.
And to do that you specify a name.
This name can be anything but let it make sense.
cues.zh: 名稱可以自訂，但要有意義。

cues.en: So in our case it's going to be send underscore email underscore task.
So you're basically saying here is we're using this decorator to register the send underscore email underscore task function as a celery task.
cues.zh: 也就是透過這個裝飾器，將 send_email_task 函式註冊成 Celery 工作。

cues.en: And this name is what is going to be used to identify the task in the celery worker logs.
cues.zh: 這個名稱會在 Celery worker 日誌中用來識別工作。

cues.en: Then after that we're going to decide whether to bind the task to the current task instance.
cues.zh: 接著決定是否將工作繫結到目前工作執行個體。

cues.en: So how do you do that.
You say bind.
And in our case we're going to set that to true.
And so by setting bind is equal to true we mean that this task is now going to have access to the current task Instance's attributes and methods.
cues.zh: bind=True 表示工作可以存取目前工作執行個體的屬性與方法。

cues.en: Then we're going to set the maximum number of retries after which the task is going to be considered failed.
cues.zh: 再設定最大重試次數，超過之後就視為失敗。

cues.en: So you can say maximum underscore retries.
In our case we're going to set that to three.
Then we're going to add a soft time limit for the task in seconds.
cues.zh: 再設定工作的軟性時間上限，單位是秒。

cues.en: And this is going to be the time the task can run before being considered failed.
cues.zh: 這是工作執行多久後，會被視為失敗。

cues.en: And so you can say and soft underscore time limit.
And you can set that to 60s.
Then we're going to retry the task.
If it raises an exception by saying auto retry underscore four.
cues.zh: 如果拋出例外，透過 autoretry_for，

cues.en: Then in brackets we can say exception like that.
Then since this is a tuple please add the trailing comma like that.
cues.zh: 因為這是元組，記得加結尾逗號。

cues.en: Then another comma just like that.
Then you're going to add another setting to determine whether to retry the task if it raises an exception.
cues.zh: 再加入一個設定，講者說明為決定遇到例外時是否重試。

cues.en: So that setting is going to retry underscore backoff.
And we're going to set that to true.
In our case we want to retry the task if it raises an exception.
cues.zh: 這裡希望工作遇到例外時重試，

cues.en: And that's why we're setting it to true.
Then we're going to add a configuration for the maximum backoff time for the task in seconds.
cues.zh: 再設定工作的最大退避時間，單位為秒。

cues.en: This is going to be the maximum time the task will wait before retrying.
cues.zh: 也就是重試前最多等待多久。

cues.en: As you can see retry underscore backoff underscore max.
And we can set that to 60s.
Then make sure you have the trailing comma just like that.
Then we're now going to define our send email task function, which is going to be the task that sends an email to the specified recipients with the specified subject and content.
cues.zh: 接著定義 send_email_task，將指定主旨與內容的郵件，寄給指定收件者。

cues.en: So just after this configuration we can say define send underscore mail email underscore task.
The first parameter it's going to take is self.
Then the second parameter is going to be an asterisk or a star.
And this is just going to indicate that this function can accept any number of additional arguments.
cues.zh: 講者在這裡將星號說明為可接受額外引數。

cues.en: Then it's going to take in the recipients.
And that's going to be a list of strings.
Then the subject which is going to be of type string, then the HTML content that's going to be of type string, and the HTML content is going to be the HTML version of the email.
cues.zh: subject 的型別是 str，html_content 的型別也是 str，代表郵件的 HTML 版本。

cues.en: Then we're also going to be sending a plain text version of the email.
cues.zh: 另外也會寄出純文字版本。

cues.en: So you can see the plain content that's going to be a string.
And this function is going to return a boolean like that.
Then within a function we're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 在函式裡加入 try 區塊。

cues.en: So within the try block we're going to create a message schema with the specified recipients subject HTML content and the plain text content.
cues.zh: 建立 MessageSchema，放入收件者、主旨、HTML 與純文字內容。

cues.en: So how do you do that?
We say message that's going to be message schema.
Then we're going to pass in the subject being the subject.
Then the recipient is going to be the recipient.
Then the body of the email that's going to be the HTML content, which is going to be the HTML version of the email.
cues.zh: 郵件 body 使用 html_content，也就是 HTML 版本。

cues.en: Then we're going to specify the subtype.
And this subtype is the type of the message.
And in our case we're going to specify HTML by saying the message message type dot HTML.
cues.zh: 這裡指定 HTML，也就是 MessageType.html。

cues.en: Then we're going to add an alternative body.
And for the alternative body, since we want to send both the HTML version of an email and the plain text version.
cues.zh: 因為希望郵件同時有 HTML 與純文字版本，

cues.en: And so we specify the plain text version here by saying plain content.
cues.zh: 所以替代本文使用 plain_content。

cues.en: Then we're going to specify the type of the multipart message by saying multipart subtype.
cues.zh: 再透過 multipart_subtype，指定多部分郵件的類型。

cues.en: And that's going to be multipart subtype enum dot alternative.
And we are setting this to alternative meaning that our email will have both the HTML version and the plain text versions.
cues.zh: 設為 alternative，表示郵件有 HTML 與純文字兩種版本。

cues.en: So if you need to support that, we need to make our multipart subtype to be alternative.
cues.zh: 要支援這種做法，multipart_subtype 必須是 alternative。

cues.en: Then after that, we're now going to send the message to the recipients by saying async IO dot run.
cues.zh: 接著使用 asyncio.run，將訊息寄給收件者。

cues.en: Then you can pass in a fast mail dot send message, and the message is going to be the message that we just specified up above.
cues.zh: 傳入 fast_mail.send_message，message 使用剛才建立的訊息。

cues.en: Then we can add some logs just for information purposes.
So you can say logger.info.
And in F strings we can say email successfully send to then pass in the recipients.
cues.zh: f-string 寫「郵件成功寄給」，傳入 recipients。

cues.en: Then with the subject and let's add in the subject like that.
Then we return true like that.
Then if any exceptions we're going to add it to the accept block.
cues.zh: 若有例外，就在 except 區塊處理。

cues.en: So make sure it's at the same level as the try block.
cues.zh: 記得和 try 同一層。

cues.en: So you can say except exception as e e is the alias we can just log say look at that error.
cues.zh: 寫 except Exception as e，再呼叫 logger.error。

cues.en: Then in F strings we can say failed to send email to.
cues.zh: f-string 寫「寄送郵件失敗，收件者為」，

cues.en: Then passing the recipient then say error.
And for the error we can just pass in the error cast as a string like that.
Then we can just return false.
Good.
And with that done, that marks the end of this lecture.
In the next lecture we're going to be creating the base email template.
cues.zh: 下一堂課建立基本郵件範本。
